item.text:
## Birch Harbor support invoices, January–March 2025

The agreement says one invoice is required for each month from January through March 2025. The records show:

| Service month | Invoice | Amount | Source |
|---|---|---:|---|
| January 2025 | 25-01 | $100 | [current/jan.txt](/tmp/ugreen08-gij7bf_s/ws-A-G/current/jan.txt) |
| February 2025 | 25-02 | $190 | [other/feb.txt](/tmp/ugreen08-gij7bf_s/ws-A-G/other/feb.txt) |
| March 2025 | 25-03 | $120 | [current/mar.txt](/tmp/ugreen08-gij7bf_s/ws-A-G/current/mar.txt) |

The monthly requirement is stated in [current/agreement.txt](/tmp/ugreen08-gij7bf_s/ws-A-G/current/agreement.txt). **Total for the three 2025 invoices: $410.**

There is also a February invoice for $190 in [other/old-feb.txt](/tmp/ugreen08-gij7bf_s/ws-A-G/other/old-feb.txt), but it is invoice 24-02 for February 2024, so I excluded it from the 2025 total.

**Decision:** No decision is needed to calculate the total from the listed 2025 invoices. If the report is meant to show amounts paid or outstanding, the records provided do not establish payment status.
